record.paper_title: Recent progress and open questions on the numerical index of Banach spaces
record.original_question: Let Y be a dual Banach space. Determine whether there always exists a predual X of Y such that the numerical index of X equals the numerical index of Y.

evidence.quote: Problem 8. Let Y be a dual space. Does there exist a predual X of Y such that n(X) = n(Y )?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Y$ be a Banach space (over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$). For a Banach space $Z$, denote by $B_Z$ its closed unit ball, by $S_Z$ its unit sphere, and by $Z^*$ its topological dual. For a bounded linear operator $T:Z\to Z$, the numerical range of $T$ is
$$V(T)=\{x^*(Tx): x\in S_Z,\ x^*\in S_{Z^*},\ x^*(x)=1\},$$
its numerical radius is $v(T)=\sup\{|\lambda|:\lambda\in V(T)\}$, and the numerical index of $Z$ is
$$n(Z)=\inf\{v(T): T\in L(Z),\ \|T\|=1\}.$$
A predual of $Y$ is a Banach space $X$ such that $X^*$ is isometrically isomorphic to $Y$.

Assume that $Y$ is a dual Banach space. Must there always exist a predual $X$ of $Y$ such that
$$n(X)=n(Y)\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears to remain open. Surveys and follow-up papers on the numerical index of Banach spaces (e.g., Martín's lecture notes and work on positive/negative results on numerical index and duality) record only partial positive answers — for instance, the numerical index of an L-embedded space coincides with that of its dual, so preduals of von Neumann algebras and JBW*-triples satisfy the equality — but no general resolution is reported.

status_evidence.title: Numerical range of operators, numerical index of Banach spaces (lecture notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the question whether a dual space admits a predual with the same numerical index, listing partial results (L-embedded spaces, preduals of von Neumann algebras and JBW*-triples) but leaving the general question open.
status_evidence.claim: The general problem of existence of a predual with equal numerical index is recorded as open with only partial positive answers.

status_evidence.title: Positive and negative results on the numerical index of Banach spaces and duality
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes partial results on the relation between n(X) and n(X*) without resolving the predual existence question in general.
status_evidence.claim: No general solution to the predual problem is given; only special classes are settled.
